[size=3]☕[/size][size=5]⊹꙳[font=Times New Roman] How to Install [/font][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]You need to have latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod & Extract [CP] Sebastian's Sprites by Macchiato folder into .../Stardew Valley/Mods/.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.Optimized some movements and fixed some bugs.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][font=Times New Roman][size=3]☕[/size][size=5]⊹꙳ Compatibility[/size][/font]

[list]
[*][size=3]If you install another (CP) mod that edit Sebastian's sprites, it may cause conflicts and invalidate this mod. [/size]
[*][size=3]You’re supposed to disable Sebastian's content for this sprites to show up. Also the Spouse Portrait.[/size]
[/list][i]
[/i][size=3]  ⊹꙳ If you have any problems with it, please let me know in the comments. I hope you enjoy this mod!
﻿Besides, I currently have no intention of making other characters. Thank you all for liking it💕
[/size]

•┈┈┈┈┈┈୨୧┈┈┈┈┈┈•

[/size]
